scripts.build: nuxt generate && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=fs.existsSync('.vercel/output/static')?'.vercel/output/static':(fs.existsSync('.output/public')?'.output/public':null); if(src){fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,'dist',{recursive:true}); console.log('Successfully prepared dist from '+src);}"
